title: Embedded windows not redrawn borders after unfocus
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.6.1-stable (and before too)

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (Cinnamon) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - PITCAIRN (radeonsi, , ACO, DRM 2.51, 6.18.7-100.fc42.x86_64) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4770 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 31.27 GiB memory

### Issue description

Losing focus does not trigger redrawing of embedded windows. Windows emit `focus_exited` signal, but are not redrawn. A window is only redrawn if previously focused element was also a window.

In example, this is clearly visible in video. I'm using custom theme for windows, where `embedded_border` is a blue panel and `embedded_unfocused_border` is a red panel.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9f4bbcc-f608-49e8-bf50-2847b343ecb0

While I’m clicking on windows, focus works as expected, border redrawn. But when I start clicking outside the windows, borders not redrawn.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create two embedded windows.
2. Click on first window.
3. Click outside windows.
4. Click on second windows.
5. Two windows border looks like focused.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[unfocus-window-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26054232/unfocus-window-mrp.zip)
